Message:
chelsio: Remove addressof casts to same type

Using addressof then casting to the original type is pointless,
so remove these unnecessary casts.

Done via coccinelle script:

$ cat typecast.cocci
@@
type T;
T foo;
@@

-	(T *)&foo
+	&foo
